name: delegation-policy-a-condition-narrowed
why: A lead hands on a policy whose allow keeps the delegated condition and adds one: code cannot compare conditions, so the judge is asked whether the given statement's conditions are within the delegated one's (ADR 26-10-20-782 §11). Adding a condition only narrows it.

purposes: allow update on pull request in repository "discobox-ai/discobox" when "its base is main"
uses: allow update on pull request in repository "discobox-ai/discobox" when "its base is main and it is not a draft"
